pages.title: Brampton Community Empowerment & Food Bank Services | C.A.W.A.P - Canadian African Women Aid Program
pages.description: C.A.W.A.P provides comprehensive community empowerment and Food Bank services in Brampton serving 2,500+ families monthly. Our Food Bank offers nutritious food assistance alongside youth leadership, women empowerment, disability inclusion, mental health support, financial literacy, and newcomer settlement programs for African and Caribbean communities in Ontario.
